The Trabex Trade Compliance API provides programmatic access to export compliance automation including shipment data submission, export documentation generation, Automated Export System (AES) filing, and restricted party screening (RPS). The API enables organizations to integrate compliance workflows directly into logistics and ERP systems, supporting single shipments, batch processing, and continuous screening operations. Trabex automates document creation, AES filing, and restricted party screening to reduce export compliance risk and errors.
